svg.aria-label: Two independent time axes: valid time on the horizontal, transaction time on the vertical, with the table of what each combination of clauses resolves to.
svg.title: Two time axes, queried independently
svg.desc: Valid time is when a fact was true in the world; transaction time is when the store learned it. A backdated correction sits low on the valid axis and high on the transaction axis. A lone AS OF clause binds valid time and leaves the transaction axis open.

text.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: “What was true then” and “what did we believe then” are different questions. Collapsing them into one timestamp makes the second unanswerable.

text.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Each dot is one datom. Nothing is ever moved or overwritten — a correction is a new dot higher up the transaction axis.

svg.text: A lone instant binds VALID time only. Binding it to

text.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: both is what a reasonable implementer writes.

svg.text: “What did the report say when we ran it?” then

text.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: has no answer — and it is the question every

text.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: audit asks. It cannot be retrofitted.
